name: holding_product
input_text: Image 1: crop of the shopper's hand near the shelf zone (faces are blurred). Image 2: crop of the shelf the hand just left.
instructions: Is the shopper's hand holding a product that was taken from this shelf? Answer true only if a product package is visibly gripped in the hand and it plausibly matches products on the shelf. An empty hand, a phone, a bag, a basket handle or the shopper's own belongings is false.
